1.consolidated_definition: Fruto del almendro tropical que en nada se parece a la almendra de las tierras templadas, como las españolas. Tiene forma ovalada del tamaño de un huevo de gallina, pero algo plano. Su pulpa es fibrosa y color rojizo azulado. No es comestible, aunque la semilla, que se parece a la del dátil, tiene sabor parecido al de la pulpa del coco. La carne está dentro de un casquito duro, difícil de abrir.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The fruit of the tropical almond tree that bears little resemblance to the almond found in temperate regions, such as those in Spain. It has an oval shape, approximately the size of a chicken egg, but slightly flat. Its pulp is fibrous and reddish-blue in color. Although it is not edible, its seed, which resembles that of the date palm, has a flavor similar to coconut pulp. The flesh is contained within a hard, difficult-to-open shell.
